Campaign Settings
Name: Campagne de démonstration
Default Game System
D&D 5E (2024)
Select default game system used by players creating characters in the campaign and to pick preferred monsters.
Vision Mode
Dynamic lighting only
Select how to reveal maps to players, see learning article for more information.
Character Permissions
Players can view but not modify all characters
Select how players can view each other's characters.
Display Names
Display complete character names
Select format of character and monster names shown on the map. Select if monster names are displayed by default or only selected.
Monster Initiative
Group monster initiatives
Should monsters of the same type share the same initiative or be calculated independently?
Extensions
D&D 2024
Select extensions to enable extended features for campaign characters.
Campaign Packages
1 selected
Select which packages of content are available for use in your campaign. If no packages are selected then all available packages will be used. Disabled packages are never allowed.
Preferred Content
Select individual content entries. Preferred content will show above other options when users make selections while disallowed content will not show.
Wallpaper Image:
Send an invitation for players to join your campaign.
Watch Mode
Watch mode provides a view to watch a campaign being played. You can use this view to broadcast or send a link for people to watch your game.
